command: QEMU=build/utm-qemu-probe/qemu-probe QEMU_VIRT='-L /Applications/UTM.app/Contents/Resources/qemu -machine virt,accel=hvf,gic-version=3 -cpu host -smp 1 -m 1024 -device virtio-ramfb -device virtio-keyboard-device -device virtio-tablet-device' ZEAL_COMPAT_LOG_PATH=build/check-demo-catalog-current-utm-qemu.log python3 -u scripts/check-compat.py --pci --quick --probe-demo-source-catalog --demo-source-path <each of the 206 upstream/pinned/Demo/**/*.ZC paths>
target: UTM-bundled QEMU / PCI ARM64 graphical guest, HVF, one vCPU
scope: Compile-only inventory of every pinned Demo .ZC source using DocRead/ExeDoc or ExeFile2 in source-specific stock module context. This does not prove runtime behavior for every demo.
scope_note: Compile acceptance only. Runtime acceptance is tracked separately in the demo source ledger; expected hardware-specific or multi-core limitations remain categorized there.
